nativeContract: Installed Objective-C static library and public header; no host/shared builder/theme/SDK/schema edits. Main-thread scene-bound iOS leases; process-wide idle reference count; exclusive screen brightness with conditional restore. macOS owns separate public IOPM display-idle assertion IDs. macOS brightness is UNSUPPORTED.

processEvidence.iOSTermination: simctl terminate followed by host process-table absence, then real new app process. iPhone lifecycle PID 4819 -> reopened PID 5307; iPad 4839 -> 5370. The authenticated verifier checks original phase identity equality and distinct restart PID.
processEvidence.ipadMultiScene: Actual two scene sessions, independent close/idle ownership and real scene-disconnect notification passed in PID 5394. No synthetic scene/window objects or fake lifecycle notifications.
processEvidence.brightnessReadback: Both actual simulator apps requested 0.37 and read 0.50000000, native status ADRStatusUnavailable=6, ownsBrightness=0. Seven brightness-dependent named cases per simulator remain PENDING; no mock grants.

retainedHistory.reason: Strict macOS collector rejected queriedProperties emitted as numeric 1 rather than Boolean true. Real 24 macOS functional cases and actual SIGKILL/query already ran; original failed artifact retained. Producer was changed to emit @YES/@NO, verifier and original expectations not weakened.

Superseded green source: 24 macOS + 33 iPhone + 33 iPad PASS, unsigned iphoneos build, 36 verifier rejection cases. iPad multi-scene activation still returned a real system error. Final revision adds all iPad orientations and explicit UIWindowScene/requestingScene configuration; original pending observations preserved here.

remainingGaps: Physical iPhone/iPad brightness acquisition, conflict, conditional restore, external Control Center changes and abrupt-termination brightness behavior need actual hardware; the simulator returned UNAVAILABLE and no such coverage is awarded.
Actual physical idle sleep/backlight effects were not measured on hosted macOS or simulators.
iPhone simulator reports supportsMultipleScenes=false; its three multi-scene cases remain pending. iPad real multi-scene cases passed.
No external display attached; external-screen brightness is deliberately UNSUPPORTED.
iphoneos target was compiled unsigned, not executed, signed for distribution, uploaded or released.
